name: io.github.nanagyamfiprempeh30/k8s-troubleshoot-mcp
title: Kubernetes Troubleshoot
description: Read-only Kubernetes diagnostics: pods, logs, events, workloads, services, PVCs and nodes.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Mount the kubeconfig read-only. This server performs no writes of any kind, so a writable mount would grant privilege it has no use for.

kubeconfig_path.description: Absolute path on the host to a kubeconfig scoped to the diagnostic ServiceAccount. Generate it with scripts/generate-kubeconfig.sh — do not mount an admin kubeconfig. The file must be readable by UID 10001, which the container runs as.

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the kubeconfig inside the container. Must match the mount destination. There is no fallback to ~/.kube/config and no in-cluster config: a missing, unreadable or malformed file is a startup failure rather than a silent downgrade to an ambient credential.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_NAMESPACES
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated namespaces the server may read, e.g. staging,production. Wildcards (* and all) are rejected at startup, and kube-system and kube-public are stripped even if listed. This is defense-in-depth, not the security boundary — the boundary is the ServiceAccount's RBAC bindings.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR. All logging goes to stderr; stdout carries the JSON-RPC stream exclusively.

environmentVariables.name: API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Kubernetes API request timeout. Must be a positive integer.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_LOG_LINES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum log lines any single get_pod_logs call may return. Must be a positive integer; clamped to a hard ceiling of 1000 with a warning.
